obligation.name: sector area and total area
obligation.input: a=1/2; four sectors with theta in [pi/4,3pi/4]

obligation.name: opposite diagonal remap
obligation.input: square area 4; four overlap areas 1; source values 2,0
obligation.expected: target values 1,1; source and target mass 4

obligation.name: flat tetrahedron
obligation.input: epsilon in (0,1), base area 1/2, height epsilon

obligation.name: identical unit squares
obligation.expected: Each closed clip retains the square; output vertices are the same four corners and shoelace area is 1.

obligation.name: edge-touching unit squares
obligation.expected: The intersection is the common vertical segment; exact zero signs retain its boundary and the fewer-than-three-noncollinear branch returns area 0.

obligation.name: disjoint unit squares
obligation.expected: A clip pass empties the cyclic vertex list; output is empty with area 0.

obligation.name: four-corner square seed
obligation.expected: The convex hull is the square; either cocircular tie resolution gives two triangles sharing one diagonal, all angles are 45 or 90 degrees, and the boundary certificates are alpha=pi/2 and sigma=1.

obligation.name: tolerance endpoint
obligation.expected: At k=4 the bound is 3*sqrt(2)/16>1/4; at k=5 it is 3*sqrt(2)/32<1/4, so exactly five complete cycles are requested if each closure call completes.

obligation.asserts: For p=1, P1 has one simple interior root and P1 prime is nonzero; there are no interior critical nodes.
obligation.claim: The root and Rolle argument has the expected endpoint-only GLL node boundary at p=1.

obligation.asserts: For p=0 the direct tail begins at n=1, and the inverse bound on constants uses mu_0=0.
obligation.claim: The lower-degree boundary in both coefficient estimates matches the displayed indices.

obligation.asserts: With at most 2C cells and degree at most 2C2, the local bound gives dim V2<=2C(2C2+1)(2C2+2)/2.
obligation.claim: The simplex dimension estimate has cubic growth in the grading index.

obligation.asserts: For p1=3 and p2=5, a common polynomial trace of degree at most 3 lies in both face spaces.
obligation.claim: The minimum face degree in the definition is the shared trace degree.
obligation.checked_in: Definition and the simplex/box branches of step 1.1 and step 1.2

obligation.asserts: For p=0, the exact factor is d|K|/|F| times the trace integral identity, and the normal derivative is zero.
obligation.claim: The p=0 trace and derivative boundary branches agree with the stated formula.

obligation.asserts: For p=1, interpolatory quadrature is exact through degree 1=2p-1.
obligation.claim: The lowest-degree exactness branch is covered.
The exact top-mode mass defect has the stated normalization.
One concrete p above the threshold has strictly negative SIPDG energy.

obligation.asserts: At p=2, the Legendre P2 norm is 2/5 and the quadrature excess is 3/5 times the squared P2 coefficient.
obligation.claim: The degree-two worked value agrees with the exact top-mode formula.

For lambda=2/3, |grad u|^2 contributes radial exponent 2lambda-1=1/3 and is integrable, while the weighted second derivative has exponent -5/3 before the area factor and gives an integrable r^-2/3 after it.
obligation.asserts: The mode is H1, outside H2, and satisfies the stated beta0=1/2 weighted-integrability branch.

obligation.claim: Under x=hy, the gradient L2 error scales by h^(lambda-1+1)=h^(2/3).
obligation.asserts: The local fixed-degree lower-bound exponent is 2/3.

obligation.claim: For q(t)=t(1-t), R(t)=1-t and Lq=x(1-x-y), which has the prescribed trace on y=0 and vanishes on x=0 and x+y=1.
obligation.asserts: Direct substitution verifies all three reference-edge traces for a nonzero polynomial.

obligation.claim: For P1(x)=x, the weighted derivative norm is integral(1-x^2)=4/3, equal to (2/3)(2!)/(0!).
obligation.asserts: The n=m=1 derivative-orthogonality normalization is exact.

obligation.claim: For f(x)=x, Pi_0 f=0 and ||f||2=sqrt(2/3) <= 1/sqrt(2)||f prime||2=1.
obligation.asserts: The first allowed projection degree N=k-1 satisfies the displayed tail estimate.

obligation.claim: For f(t)=t, the degree-one endpoint-preserving projector has derivative 1 and reproduces f exactly.
obligation.asserts: The interval branch preserves both endpoint values and has zero error on an affine polynomial.

obligation.claim: At r=5 and p=12, n=6 and eta^2=4!/6!=1/30, hence eta=1/sqrt(30)<=1/3=(4/p).
obligation.asserts: The simplified p-rate agrees with the exact factorial ratio at its first applicable degree.

obligation.claim: For neighboring degrees 1 and 3, pE=min(1,3)=1 and the single globally oriented edge projector has the same affine trace on both cells.
obligation.asserts: The lowest shared-edge degree gives matching traces without a degree-ratio restriction.
